description: The configuration of hadome, `.hadome.yml` at the repository root.

extends.description: Local files whose settings this file builds on, relative to this file. Later layers add to or override earlier ones. Never a URL.

files.description: Roles for files laid out against the languages' conventions. Globs only add a role; `**` is directories at any depth.

generated.description: Globs of files treated as generated code, which the size and comment rules skip. A file matching both lists is generated. Adding an entry takes files out of those rules, so it needs review.

tests.description: Globs of files read as test files, in every language but Go: the Go compiler decides what a Go test is (_test.go). Which files are tests moves what the rules cover both ways, so any change needs review.

gates.description: Product-specific gates: external commands that look at one version and report findings or items as JSON. Removing or changing one needs a person's review.

options.description: Anything the gate needs; passed to it untouched.

paths.description: Globs of the files passed to the gate; * stays within one path element, ** spans any number. Omitted: every file.

run.description: The command and its arguments. A command containing / is a path from the repository root; otherwise it is looked up on PATH. It runs in the root of the version being checked.

timeout.description: How long the gate may run on one version. Default 60s.

invariants.description: Promises the product keeps. Every enabled invariant must be guarded by at least one active test. Removing one needs a person's review.

target.description: What the invariant is about: a function or method, written as <unit>.<name>.

targets.description: Two or more functions the invariant is about together, such as an export and an import.

id.description: A name for the invariant. Tests that guard it say `guards: <id>` in their doc comment.

says.description: The promise in one sentence, for people.

languages.description: Languages to check. Detected when omitted.

mutation.description: hadome mutate: breaks the functions a change touched, one small change at a time, and fails when no test notices. Removing it or weakening it needs review.

max-mutants.description: How many mutants one run tries at most. Mutants beyond it are reported for review. Default 100.

test.description: The test command, run at the root of a copy of the version for every mutant. hadome never guesses it. An element holding {tests} gets the names of the tests that call the broken function; a survivor is then run again with all the tests. Any change needs review.

tests-separator.description: What joins the test names put into {tests}. Default |.

timeout.description: The limit of one test run. Omitted: three times one run before anything is broken. A run that times out caught its mutant.

rules.description: Settings of the built-in rules. Only what differs from the defaults.

todo.description: A regular expression every comment line starting with TODO, FIXME or XXX must match. Default `^TODO\([^)]+\): \S`, that is TODO(<when or who>): <what>. Changing it needs a person's review.

diagram.description: The Markdown file, from the repository root, whose Mermaid flowchart is the dependency diagram. Node labels name directories (dir, or dir/... for everything under it); an arrow a --> b lets a import b. Without it, the deps/ rules find nothing. Adding an arrow needs a person's review.

size.description: Limits of the size/ rules. Only product code is measured, never tests or generated code.

complexity.description: The most cyclomatic complexity of a function or method: 1, plus one per if, for, case, && and || allowed. Default 15.

file-lines.description: The most lines in a source file allowed. Default 400.

function-lines.description: The most lines in a function or method, from its declaration to its closing brace allowed. Default 60.

interface-methods.description: The most methods in an interface allowed. Default 5.

params.description: The most parameters of a function or method, not counting the receiver allowed. Default 5.

assertions.description: Functions that count as assertions for tests/no-assertion, in addition to the built-in ones. Write an entry as the test calls it (acme.MustEqual), or in Go as <import path>.<Name>. Entries can be added, never removed from the built-in table.

hazards.description: Calls that count as hazards in tests, in addition to the built-in ones.

clock.description: Adds functions that read the clock to the built-in table. Entries can be added, never removed from the built-in table.

mock.description: Adds import paths of mocking libraries to the built-in table. Entries can be added, never removed from the built-in table.

sleep.description: Adds functions that wait for time to pass to the built-in table. Entries can be added, never removed from the built-in table.

io.description: Adds units that perform input or output, which make every unit importing them not pure; end an entry with /... to include everything under it to the built-in table. Entries can be added, never removed from the built-in table.

title: .hadome.yml
